item.title: TinyFish Launches Two Web Research Agents for Deep Q&A and Bulk Spreadsheets
item.description:
TinyFish released two web research agents: TinyResearch produces a cited report for a single hard question, while TinySet assembles a spreadsheet from facts scattered across hundreds of sites. The pitch is to split deep digging and wide scanning into two distinct agent shapes rather than one generalist. Public details so far are positioning-level, without verifiable metrics on accuracy or coverage.

原文标题：TinyFish 推出两款网页研究智能体 分攻深度问答与批量建表

Why it matters：代表了智能体产品化中“按任务形态拆分”的一种设计取向，值得关注但尚缺硬指标。

item.title: Meta Opens Muse AI Avatar Video Chat to All US Users
item.description:
Meta has made Muse Voice generally available in the US, letting users hold real-time voice and video conversations with its consumer AI agent Muse via mobile, web, and Mac. The feature is powered by the new Muse Realtime Avatar and Muse Realtime Voice models, with planned expansion to AI Glasses and the upcoming Muse Charm device.

原文标题：Meta 向全美用户开放 Muse AI 虚拟形象视频通话

Why it matters：这是消费级 AI 智能体在实时多模态交互形态上的一次规模化落地，值得关注其产品化路径。

item.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources Cosmos 3 World Models for Interactive Simulation
item.description:
NVIDIA released the Cosmos 3 family of open world models on Hugging Face, targeting interactive world simulation with public checkpoints and example collections. The release extends the Cosmos world-foundation-model line, opening physical-world modeling to developers for simulation data generation in robotics and autonomous driving.

原文标题：NVIDIA 开源 Cosmos 3 世界模型 支持交互式仿真

Why it matters：头部厂商开源世界模型并配套检查点，直接影响仿真数据与具身智能研发路径。

item.title: OpenRouter Fixes Crouton Alpha Bug That Halted Agents Mid-Task
item.description:
OpenRouter fixed a bug in its stealth reasoning model Crouton Alpha that caused agents to stop early, typically right before a tool call; agents should now run tasks to completion. The model was previously announced as free to use with a 1M-token context, text/image/audio/video input, and no training on user data.

原文标题：OpenRouter 修复 Crouton Alpha 智能体中途停止的缺陷

Why it matters：这是一次针对智能体执行中断的常规缺陷修复，对正在试用该隐身模型的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: webAI Open-Sources TwIL-8B, a Small Model Approaching Frontier Coding and Math
item.description:
webAI has open-sourced TwIL-8B, an 8.8B-parameter model built on IBM's Granite 4.2 8B and tuned for math, coding and instruction following. It reportedly fits in a 4.98 GiB quantized file that runs on CPUs or modest GPUs, scoring 81.6% on LiveCodeBench and reaching roughly 92-93% of frontier-model performance on coding and instruction following.

原文标题：webAI 开源 TwIL-8B 小模型逼近前沿编程与数学能力

Why it matters：小参数模型在编程与数学基准上逼近前沿闭源模型，且可在消费级硬件本地运行，对关注端侧部署与开源模型的读者价值较高。

item.title: Meta Executive Warns Midterm Backlash Against Data Centers Could Slow AI Expansion
item.description:
Meta President Dina Powell McCormick said at the WSJ Tech conference that Democratic midterm wins will make data center construction significantly harder, acknowledging the industry has failed to explain the benefits of these investments. She framed local opposition as a symptom of broader public unease about AI, and said Meta aims to reverse sentiment by demonstrating value, while noting strong daily demand to lease its compute provides a monetization path regardless.

原文标题：Meta 高管警告：中期选举后数据中心遭抵制将拖慢 AI 扩张

Why it matters：这是大厂高管对 AI 基础设施政治阻力与算力变现路径的公开表态，反映产业扩张面临的现实约束。

item.title: OpenAI Opens Security Model That Found Severe Ubuntu Flaw in Two Hours
item.description:
OpenAI is giving cybersecurity defenders access to frontier models through its Daybreak Blue program, and one developer used GPT 5.6 Sol to surface a severe Ubuntu server vulnerability in about two hours; Debian has since patched it. The episode shows LLM-driven vulnerability discovery is now practical, while the piece argues the industry still lacks urgency for patching critical digital infrastructure.

原文标题：OpenAI 开放安全模型 两小时挖出 Ubuntu 高危漏洞

Why it matters：这是大模型在真实安全场景中产出可验证漏洞的落地案例，对关注模型能力边界的读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-Second Clips and 30% Price Cut
item.description:
Google DeepMind has made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available, extending clip length from 10 to 15 seconds and adding conversational editing. The model costs 30% less than its predecessor and ships across the Gemini API, AI Studio, Flow, Google Vids and other surfaces, with every output carrying an imperceptible SynthID watermark.

原文标题：Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 发布：视频时长延至 15 秒，价格降 30%

Why it matters：主流厂商视频生成模型在时长、编辑交互与价格三个维度同时推进，是评估多模态生成成本曲线的重要节点。

item.title: Science's Last Exam Benchmark Grades AI Research Agents With Hidden Expert Checks
item.description:
The US nonprofit AItonomy Foundation released Science's Last Exam (SLE), a benchmark spanning 113 tasks across 9 disciplines that hands agents real research goals, data and lab software, then grades them with expert checks the agent never sees, comparing hypotheses against studies published after model training cutoffs. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash led with 21.28% of hypotheses anticipating later research, while all models scored zero on true end-to-end research.

原文标题：Science's Last Exam 基准发布 用隐藏专家检查评测 AI 科研能力

Why it matters：它把数学领域可复现的自动评分思路迁移到实证科学，用隐藏检查与训练截止后文献构建抗记忆的科研智能体评测，结果对模型能力判断有直接参考价值。

The feature is live on iOS, with Meta promising expansion to its AI glasses and the forthcoming Muse Charm device later this year.

item.title: Verne Robotics Open-Sources V0.5 World Action Model with Stronger Robustness
item.description:
Verne Robotics released V0.5, an open-weight world action model built on the Wan2.2 video generator and trained on over 1.7M demonstrations, predicting the next second of arm, gripper and mobile-base motion. It learns new industrial tasks from under two hours of demos and degrades far less than Physical Intelligence's π0.5 under clutter and lighting shifts.

item.title: Meta Adds NTS Authentication to Public Time Service, Open Sources Stack
item.description:
Meta's public time service at nts.meta.com now supports NTS (RFC 8915), letting clients verify that time packets came from Meta and were not modified in transit. The NTS servers are stateless, with cookie keys derived rather than stored or replicated, and the protocol, server and client code are open sourced on GitHub.

原文标题：Meta 时间服务上线 NTS 并开源协议与客户端

Why it matters：为长期未认证的 NTP 补上来源验证，且整套实现开源，对基础设施与安全工程师有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Paper Finds Query Echoing Is Key to RAG Poisoning
item.description:
A new Google paper shows that RAG poisoning hinges less on the attack payload than on echoing the user's query so poisoned documents get retrieved. Across 623 queries, just 5 documents (about 0.1% of the corpus) degraded classic retriever ranking quality by 40.2% to 61.5%; filtering query-echoing documents blocked the attack but halved clean ranking quality on NFCorpus from 0.267 to 0.134.

原文标题：谷歌新论文揭示 RAG 投毒关键：复制用户查询即可污染检索

Why it matters：首次量化揭示 RAG 检索层投毒的低成本与防御代价，对构建检索增强系统的开发者有直接安全警示价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: Viktor AI Agent Adds Email Interface with Sender-Identity Access Control
item.description:
AI agent Viktor has moved from requiring a Slack or Teams install to offering a public email address, letting anyone assign tasks or book meetings by emailing or CC-ing it. Since the address is shared, access is gated by authenticated sender identity, so the agent only acts on mail from the actual user. The case suggests email, with its built-in context and identity, may be a natural interface for agents.

原文标题：Viktor 智能体新增邮箱入口 以发件人身份控制访问权限

Why it matters：展示了以邮箱和发件人身份作为智能体接入与权限边界的一种新交互范式，对关注 Agent 落地形态的读者有参考价值。

item.description:

He acknowledged a rough first half of 2026 and lagging Anthropic's Claude Code in agentic coding, but said OpenAI's enterprise standing has shifted markedly since.

item.title: Nasdaq Sinks 5% as Investors Retreat From AI Trade After Election
item.description:
Investors pulled back from the crowded AI trade after the U.S. election, driving the Nasdaq down 5% in a single session while the VIX spiked more than 62% and Bitcoin fell about 5%. The move signals a shift from one-sided AI positioning toward risk repricing, making volatility and capital rotation key variables for AI asset valuations.

原文标题：大选后投资者撤离 AI 交易 纳指单日重挫 5%

Why it matters：这是 AI 板块资金面与市场情绪的宏观信号，直接影响 AI 公司估值与融资环境。

item.title: Anthropic Adds Personal Finance Feature Linking Claude to Bank Accounts
item.description:
Anthropic launched a Personal Finance feature that connects Claude to bank and card accounts via Plaid in read-only mode, letting users get categorized spending breakdowns and answers on upcoming bills or affordability. Claude cannot move, manage, or invest money and is not designed for investment advice, but it can read account names, balances, credit limits, and up to two years of transactions.

原文标题：Claude 接入银行账户 推出个人财务分析功能

Why it matters：这是大模型助手首次以受监管的只读方式接入真实金融账户，标志着 Agent 落地高敏感场景的重要一步。

item.title: Baidu Open-Sources 280B-Parameter ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base Foundation Model
item.description:
Baidu released ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base on Hugging Face, a mixture-of-experts foundation model with 280B total parameters and 14B active per token, pre-trained on 33.5 trillion tokens with a 128K training context that can extend to one million tokens during fine-tuning and inference. It ships deliberately without fine-tuning or post-training, positioning the raw weights for developer customization, with a post-trained version to follow.

原文标题：百度开源 2800 亿参数 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 基础模型

item.title: BOSS Zhipin's Nanbeige Team Releases Open-Weights Nanbeige4.3-33B, Matching Qwen3.8 27B on Intelligence Index
item.description:
Nanbeige, the foundation model team at Chinese recruitment platform BOSS Zhipin, has released Nanbeige4.3-33B under Apache 2.0 — a dense 33B reasoning model scoring 20 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5, level with Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh). It offers a 524K-token context window, text-only I/O, and is small enough to run locally on a laptop, with terminal use and physics reasoning as relative strengths but weaker knowledge benchmarks.

item.title: OpenRouter Reports Agentic Cache Hit Rate Rising to 89% in 2026
item.description:
OpenRouter notes that the inference layer improved markedly in 2026: the median agentic cache hit rate rose from the mid-60s at the start of the year to 89%, cutting cost on the same model. Beyond raw model capability, caching in the inference stack is becoming a key cost lever.

原文标题：OpenRouter：2026 年智能体缓存命中率升至 89%

Why it matters：来自主流模型路由平台的实测口径数据，量化了推理层缓存优化对智能体成本的实质影响。

item.title: Eon Launches Yukon Serverless Data Engine for Agent Data Layer
item.description:
Eon released Yukon, a serverless data engine that ingests, cleans and compacts events into open Iceberg tables in the customer's own bucket, with agents reading table context over MCP. Eon's public benchmark claims 4x less compute than Spark and 7x less than Flink, driven by letting agents understand table contents before querying to avoid wasted scans.

原文标题：Eon 推出 Yukon 无服务器数据引擎 面向智能体数据层

Why it matters：智能体数据层是当前落地瓶颈之一，该产品给出可复现的公开基准与开放表格式方案，值得关注。

item.title: Rivet 开源 Actor 运行时 让智能体在 S3 上轻量编排
item.description:

Why it matters：为智能体基础设施提供了一条区别于沙箱的轻量编排路线，且开源可自托管，值得关注其真实负载表现。
